<thought>Only chlorine shows a clear, characteristic isotopic pattern: the M+2 peak (≈212 Da) is about one‑third the intensity of the monoisotopic peak, matching the natural 35Cl/37Cl abundance ratio. No other element exhibits a distinctive pattern at the observed intensities (e.g., bromine would give an M+2 ≈ 100 % of M, sulfur would give a much smaller M+2). Therefore, chlorine is the only element that can be definitively identified from the spectrum.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl']</final_answer>
